newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Fudosan sells land to cut debts.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Fudosan sells land to cut debts.

text.p: Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it had sold part of the land it owned in Tokyo at a loss of 5.28 billion yen as part of efforts to cut its debts and eventually improve its financial health.
The land was sold to Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd on Tuesday, Mitsui Fudosan said in a statement.

The loss from the land sale will be included as an extraordinary loss for the year to March 31, 1997, Mitsui Fudosan said, adding that it has already been factored into the company's parent and group earnings forecasts announced on March 12.
Mitsui Fudosan, a leading real estate developer, said then that it expects to post a parent current loss of 65 billion yen in 1996/97 against an actual 1995/96 current profit of 8.41 billion yen.
